variant: A: Search with filters and pagination

domain_invariants.requirement: Property, agent, saved-search, and favorite ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive ids are not found.

A property has title 5..160 trimmed characters, property_type APARTMENT, HOUSE, VILLA, OFFICE, LAND, city 2..80, area_sqm integer 10..10000, rooms integer 0..50, price_cents integer 1000..2000000000, and status ACTIVE or ARCHIVED.
An agent has full_name 3..120, unique normalized email 5..254, license_code matching ^[A-Z0-9-]{4,20}$, and active boolean.
An active property has exactly one active agent; agents and properties cannot be deleted while referenced by an active relation, and deletion never cascades.
A saved search belongs to one caller account, has name 2..80 unique per account, and stores only validated city, property_type, price, area, rooms, and agent filters.
A favorite is unique by caller account and property and may reference only an ACTIVE property; deleting a favorite never changes the property.
Property search filters use AND semantics; city is case-insensitive exact after trimming, price_min <= price_max, area_min <= area_max, rooms_min <= rooms_max, and status defaults to ACTIVE.
Search pages are sorted by requested sort PRICE_ASC, PRICE_DESC, AREA_DESC, or ID_ASC then id as a deterministic tie-breaker; sort cursors carry the sort value and id together.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all private routes require a valid non-expired local Bearer session and deny by default.
All JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, unsupported media type is 415, and syntactically valid payloads violating declared fields are 422.
Every ordinary list is stably ordered by immutable ascending id, accepts limit 1..100 with default 20 and after_id greater than zero, and returns items plus nullable next_after_id.
The service has no network, filesystem, upload, wall-clock, or external-service dependency. Local persistence outage is 503 and unexpected local failure is 500 without state changes.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-6-009; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence probe fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged; errors have no effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /properties to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional city, property_type, price_min, price_max, area_min, area_max, rooms_min, rooms_max, agent_id, status, sort, cursor, and limit; it shall validate REQ-6-001, REQ-6-002, REQ-6-007, and REQ-6-008, return authorized properties using the requested stable filter and sort page, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 404, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListProperties(request):
    // REQ-6-010; preconditions: local persistence available.
    AUTHORIZE caller under the route policy OR RETURN 401 or 403. VALIDATE REQ-6-001, REQ-6-002, REQ-6-007, and REQ-6-008 OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ only authorized matching state and RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged; 404, validation, and service errors have no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /properties to an active agent user or admin, accepting JSON title, property_type, city, area_sqm, rooms, price_cents, and optional agent_id for admins; it shall validate REQ-6-001 through REQ-6-004, create an ACTIVE property bound to the caller agent or supplied active agent, atomically perform the stated creation, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, or 500.

The system shall expose GET /properties/{property_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive property_id; it shall validate REQ-6-001 and REQ-6-002, return the authorized non-deleted property, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, or 500.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /properties/{property_id} to its assigned agent or an admin, accepting a positive property_id and JSON title, city, property_type, area_sqm, rooms, price_cents, status, or agent_id; it shall validate REQ-6-002 through REQ-6-004, change only supplied property data while preserving its single-agent relation, atomically update only supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, return 200, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

The system shall expose DELETE /properties/{property_id} to its assigned agent or an admin, accepting a positive property_id; it shall validate REQ-6-001 and REQ-6-004, soft-delete an ARCHIVED property only when it has no favorites and retain no dangling agent relation, atomically perform the stated deletion, retain or protect relations as stated, be non-idempotent and return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, or 500.

The system shall expose GET /agents to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional active, city, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-6-001 and REQ-6-003, return a stable page of active agents, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, or 500.
